en: A sepia-toned portrait photograph of an Orthodox Christian clergyman wearing a tall cylindrical hat (kalimavkion), a long robe, and a thick beard. He has medals around his neck and pinned to his chest, with one resembling a star. The border at the bottom contains Cyrillic script, and there is handwriting both at the bottom and the top right corner. The bottom right corner also includes the names of two cities: ВАРНА-БУРГАС (Varna-Burgas).
